title: Degree-zero restriction data in the cartesian open-subscheme square
statement:
Let $R,S$ be commutative rings, $S$ an $R$-algebra, $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ a scheme morphism, $M$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module, and $j:W\hookrightarrow X$ an open subscheme. Use the constructions of [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison]. Put $X_S=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}R}\operatorname{Spec}S$, $W_S=W\times_{\operatorname{Spec}R}\operatorname{Spec}S$, and write $p:X_S\to X$, $p_W:W_S\to W$, $f_S:X_S\to\operatorname{Spec}S$ and $f_{W,S}:W_S\to\operatorname{Spec}S$ for the projections. Define $k:W_S\to X_S$ to be the unique map with $p\circ k=j\circ p_W$ and $f_S\circ k=f_{W,S}$. Write $U$ for forgetting modules to abelian sheaves, and put $F=U(M)$, $F_W=U(j^*M)$, $N=U(p^*M)$ and $N_W=U(p_W^*j^*M)$. Let $\varphi:p^{-1}F\to N$ and $\varphi_W:p_W^{-1}F_W\to N_W$ be the abelian adjoints of the module pullback units. Let $\rho:R\to\operatorname{End}(F)$ and $\rho_W:R\to\operatorname{End}(F_W)$ be multiplication through $f$ and $f\circ j$, and let $\tau:S\to\operatorname{End}(N)$ and $\tau_W:S\to\operatorname{End}(N_W)$ be multiplication through $f_S$ and $f_{W,S}$. Let $L_W$ and $L_{\top,W}$ be the free abelian sheaves represented by $W$ and by the top open of $W$, respectively [lem-pc-free-mayer-vietoris-short-exact]. Put $J=j^{-1}$, $J'=k^{-1}$, $G=p^{-1}$ and $G_W=p_W^{-1}$. There are sheaf isomorphisms $e:J L_W\cong L_{\top,W}$, $d:J F\cong F_W$, $d':J'N\cong N_W$, and a natural isomorphism $c:J'G\cong G_WJ$, such that for all $a\in R$ and $b\in S$,
$$d\circ J(\rho(a))=\rho_W(a)\circ d,\qquad d'\circ J'(\tau(b))=\tau_W(b)\circ d',$$
and
$$d'\circ J'(\varphi)=\varphi_W\circ G_W(d)\circ c_F.$$
This statement asserts only degree-zero sheaf data and morphism squares, with no Ext equivalences and no Ext bijectivity.

source.place: Open restriction and extension adjunction (00A7, 03DI); localization of morphisms of ringed sites (04J0); coefficient units and functoriality (01F7). The scalar and coefficient squares are the degree-zero specialization of these constructions.

proof.text: Restriction along the open inclusion identifies the represented free sheaf with the free sheaf on the top open, by the free/forgetful, sheafification and section adjunctions. This gives e. Identify inverse image of the underlying coefficient sheaf with the underlying module restriction; choose d to be the abelian adjoint of the pullback unit. Naturality for multiplication by a global section gives its R-scalar square.

The two composites of inverse images are left adjoints to the same direct-image composite because p composed with k equals j composed with p_W. Their unique adjunction comparison gives c. The module pullback composition comparisons for the same equality give d′; their naturality for sections from Spec S gives the S-scalar square.

Compose the two module pullback units in each route of the cartesian square. Under the composition comparison these units agree, since both are adjoint to the identity on the same pullback module. Applying the abelian adjunction and cancelling its unit/counit identities gives d′ composed with J′(phi) equal to phi_W composed with G_W(d) composed with c_F. Empty opens and zero modules give zero coefficient sheaves, and the argument also covers the top open.

lean.statement:
theorem H.openRestrictionData (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of R)) (M : X.Modules) (W : X.Opens) :
    let F := (SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj M
    let G := invImage (baseChangeFst (S := S) f)
    let N := (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (baseChangedScheme (S := S) f).ringCatSheaf).obj
      (baseChangedModule (S := S) f M)
    let φ := coeff (baseChangeFst (S := S) f) (baseChangeUnit (S := S) f M)
    let ρ := (scalarRep M).comp (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv ≫ f.appTop).hom)
    let τ := (scalarRep (baseChangedModule (S := S) f M)).comp
      (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of S)).inv ≫ (baseChangeSnd (S := S) f).appTop).hom)
    let MW := (pullback W.ι).obj M
    let FW := (SheafOfModules.toSheaf W.toScheme.ringCatSheaf).obj MW
    let GW := invImage (baseChangeFst (S := S) (W.ι ≫ f))
    let NW := (SheafOfModules.toSheaf
      (baseChangedScheme (S := S) (W.ι ≫ f)).ringCatSheaf).obj
      (baseChangedModule (S := S) (W.ι ≫ f) MW)
    let φW := coeff (baseChangeFst (S := S) (W.ι ≫ f))
      (baseChangeUnit (S := S) (W.ι ≫ f) MW)
    let ρW := (scalarRep MW).comp
      (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv ≫ (W.ι ≫ f).appTop).hom)
    let τW := (scalarRep (baseChangedModule (S := S) (W.ι ≫ f) MW)).comp
      (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of S)).inv ≫ (baseChangeSnd (S := S) (W.ι ≫ f)).appTop).hom)
    let J := invImage W.ι
    let J' := invImage (H.openBaseChangeInclusion (S := S) f W)
    ∃ (e : J.obj (H.openFreeSheaf W) ≅ H.openFreeSheaf (⊤ : W.toScheme.Opens))
      (d : J.obj F ≅ FW) (c : G ⋙ J' ≅ J ⋙ GW) (d' : J'.obj N ≅ NW),
      (∀ a, J.map (ρ a) ≫ d.hom = d.hom ≫ ρW a) ∧
      (∀ a, J'.map (τ a) ≫ d'.hom = d'.hom ≫ τW a) ∧
      J'.map φ ≫ d'.hom = (c.app F).hom ≫ GW.map d.hom ≫ φW
